title: Gas Station
summary: Find the station from which a car with an empty tank can drive once around a circular route without running dry.

tests.explain: Start at station 3: fill 5, drive to station 0 using 1 (4 left). Fill 3 and use 2 (5 left), fill 1 and use 4 (2 left), fill 2 and use 3 (1 left), and you are back at station 3.
There are 6 units of gas in total but the whole loop costs 8, so no start can work.
One station: fill 4 units and spend 3 to drive around back to it.

hints: First a quick test: if the total gas is less than the total cost, no start can work. Is the reverse also true?
Simulate from station 0, keeping the tank. Suppose the tank goes negative on the way from station i to i + 1. Could any station between the start and i have been a better start?
No: each of them would arrive at i with even less gas. So restart from i + 1 with an empty tank. If the total is non-negative, the last restart point is the answer.
